The Rhineland ( German : Rheinland [ˈʁaɪnlant] ⓘ ; Dutch : Rijnland ; Kölsch : Rhingland ; Latin : Rhenania ) is a loosely defined area of Western Germany along the Rhine , chiefly its middle section , sometimes encompassing parts of Belgium . It is the main industrial heartland of Germany because of its many factories, and it has historic ties to the Holy Roman Empire , Prussia , and the German Empire .
